rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - research-oom-daemon-comparison [ses_f221dc2afffeeNpSQ4N6kFGC4e].md:L3851] `DefaultMemoryPressureWatch` / `DefaultMemoryPressureThresholdSec` are `systemd-system.conf(5)` settings for the per-service `MemoryPressureWatch=` event mechanism (added v254), **not** `systemd-oomd` thresholds. `DefaultSwapThresholdSec` does not exist upstream at all. The real oomd knobs are `SwapUsedLimit=` (90%), `DefaultMemoryPressureLimit=` (60%), `DefaultMemoryPressureDurationSec=` (30 s).
